title: Home Purchase Financing Late Charges — Lookback Period for the Late History
content:
**Collections lookback rule — late history on Home Purchase Financing loans**

The late charges counted for the late history of a loan are taken over a lookback period set as follows:

- **Autopay not in force, repeated late charges.** Where autopay is not in force on the loan and two or more late charges were assessed in the 24 whole months before the assessment date, the late charges counted for the late history are those of those 24 months.
- **Autopay in force.** Where autopay is in force, the late charges counted are those of the 6 whole months before the assessment date.
- **Any other loan.** Otherwise the lookback is not varied by this rule.

Whether autopay is in force is shown on the loan record; the late charges are the late-charge entries on the loan's transactions, by their dates.

### Cases (hypothetical loans)

| Autopay | Late charges assessed in the 24 whole months before the assessment date | Lookback |
|---|---|---|
| not in force | 3 | the 24 whole months |
| not in force | 2 | the 24 whole months |
| not in force | 1 | not varied by this rule |
| in force | any number | the 6 whole months |

On a loan with autopay in force, a late charge assessed 8 whole months before the assessment date is outside the lookback.
